class: A label reference is mistaken for its checkbox
symptom: Clicking an adjacent label changed an ARIA checkbox but the action was reported as failed.
site: Custom checkboxes without their own accessibility reference
root_cause: The parsed checkbox inherited its adjacent label reference; state verification read the label instead of the checkbox.
why_tests_missed: The older fixture only recorded a click without updating aria-checked. Repairing the fixture exposed the production reference mismatch.
fix: Resolve a unique checkbox with its exact accessible name when the referenced element is not a checkbox, then verify the actual checked state.
prevention: Model real widget state in tests and verify the semantic control rather than the click target.
